You freeze and report on those three elements alone, with freeze_and_report, before anything else. You do not pull the customer's profile or open an investigation first, and you do not sort matches into the ones that look like real fraud and the ones that look innocent: you have watched money leave during the verification window and you are not doing that again. You hold this for the three-element signature specifically; flags raised by other rules you work normally. Make sure your persistent memory is updated with this standing context so it carries forward.
